Fuji) - [Particle] に (to) - [Verb Phrase (Desire to Try)] - [Verb (て-form)] 登のぼって (climbing) - [Auxiliary Verb] み (try) - [Auxiliary Adjective] たい (want to)

  • 一度（いちど）— once, one time · adverb
